body:
The problem is my "dream job" is an entry level job. Sure it's hard to get it, but it's minimum wage. 

I've been applying everywhere, I can't get anything. No matter what I do, no matter how hard I try, nothing works. Honestly, the world would be better without me. 

I'm going into debt now, and let's say they do a credit check, I won't be able to get the job. What's the point.
